payload.body:
## Context
A local auth service now handles GitHub browser OAuth callbacks via `auth.hack.gy` and localhost fallback. We need to keep this as a stable integration entrypoint for additional providers.

## Goals
- Define provider callback contract for auth server routes
- Add provider registration surface (`/v1/auth/providers` already present) with typed status payloads
- Document callback security model and host/routing requirements

## Notes
- Keep daemon-owned auth service lightweight
- Prefer keychain/secret-ref storage for provider secrets and tokens

## Links
- src/daemon/routes/auth.ts
- src/daemon/server.ts
- src/templates.ts
- docs/extensions.md
payload.title: Generalize local auth server for provider callbacks
